sampling temperature

  • CURIE: gmeow:samplingTemperature
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/samplingTemperature
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/ai
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The temperature parameter of this invocation. Sampling parameters are claim provenance: the same prompt at temperature 0 and 1.2 are different epistemic acts.

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:ModelInvocation -> xsd:decimal

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:samplingTemperature from gmeow:ModelInvocation to xsd:decimal when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:ModelInvocation

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to record the temperature of a gmeow:ModelInvocation as part of its provenance — the same prompt at temperature 0 versus 1.2 is a different epistemic act.

Avoid when

  • Avoid placing it on the model agent or card (it is per-invocation, not per-model) and avoid treating it as an output quality score; it is an input setting, claim provenance.

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:samplingTemperature as a decimal on the gmeow:ModelInvocation alongside gmeow:samplingTopP and gmeow:samplingMaxTokens so the sampling regime is fully recoverable.

Examples

  • ex:inv1 gmeow:samplingTemperature 0.7.
